==Description==
'''Bunny Mech''' emote is an emote that could be obtained at level 39 of the premium [[Ducky Revenge Event#Ducky Revenge Battle Pass|Ducky Revenge Battle Pass]]. It was made by STEALTH_NOVA, Vylith and JohnDrinkin. The emote is looped and moveable, but not interactable. No music can be heard while performing this emote.

When performed, the player is placed into a giant bunny mech, which decreases movement speed but greatly boosts jump power, allowing the player to jump up to higher points on the map.

It had a cost of {{DuckyEggs|1,410}} or {{Robux|108}} ({{Robux|91}} during the Memorial Day 2025 Sale) to unlock it, with a total cost of {{DuckyEggs|25,630}} or {{Robux|3,430}} ({{Robux|2,897}} during the Memorial Day 2025 Sale).

==Trivia==
*The '''Bunny Mech''' emote is based on the [[Nerd Ducky]]'s bunny mech.
*The description for this emote is a reference to the [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/big-chungus Big Chungus] meme.
